sentences.en: She placed the book on the bookrest beside her chair.
sentences.zh: 她把书放在椅子旁边的书架上。

sentences.en: The old-fashioned bookrest adds a touch of elegance to the room.
sentences.zh: 这个老式的书架为房间增添了一抹优雅。

sentences.en: He adjusted the angle of his bookrest so he could read more comfortably.
sentences.zh: 他调整了书架的角度，以便更舒服地阅读。
